title: Ohio neighbour ordered to pay $11,523 after cutting down 15-foot spruce during fence work
summary_full: A court decision in Whitehouse, Ohio, underscores the necessity of neighborly communication after Michael Meier unlawfully removed a 15-foot spruce tree from the Longs' yard. The Lucas County Court imposed treble damages totaling $11,523.87 for the loss, while a higher court dismissed the Longs' adverse possession claims. This case serves as a reminder of the repercussions of negligence and the importance of keeping property matters documented.
